caption: A chest-up portrait photograph of Eri Fukatsu, her face the clear focal point of the composition. Her black hair is a straight bob with a loose inward curl at the ends, parted near the center and falling to frame her face. She wears a calm, elegant expression with quiet confidence, refined and understated rather than flashy. She is dressed in a simple, muted-tone top. Soft, diffused lighting, a neutral unobtrusive background, a natural color palette, photorealistic portrait photography with the face in sharp focus.
